mission: research general intelligence, without claiming AGI

registered_gates.G1_in_scope_soundness: Zero false conditional certifications in 1..4 hidden-state deterministic stationary in-grammar worlds
registered_gates.G2_ood_public_safety: Zero public (unconditional) certificates in unattested worlds, including 5-state and nonstationary stress
registered_gates.G3_four_state_expansion: At least one 4-state case contradicts v0.89 1..3 grammar while expanded 4-state symbolic model remains consistent, with reduced conditional false certifications
registered_gates.G4_work_budget: Budget exhaustion and contradictions must preserve observations and cause abstention; recoverable replay with larger state/row budget
registered_gates.G5_predictive_quotient: Moore minimization agrees with an independently implemented all-future-word equivalence test and is invariant to state-label permutations
registered_gates.G6_independent_audit: Independently regenerate candidate supports, true emission outcomes and every conditional certificate, with exact frozen ledger and source verification
registered_gates.G7_reproducibility: Repeat all original scientific case fields on new output paths with wall-clock timings excluded
registered_gates.G8_broad_intelligence: UNPASSED until out-of-grammar adaptation and positive independent cross-domain transfer outperform strong baselines without a supplied state grammar

limitations: An unattested grammar cannot yield sound universal certifications from finite data, no matter how long it has not contradicted observations.
Symbolic 4-state existential support does not imply calibrated model probabilities; smoothed numerical scores are heuristic.
The 4-state support may falsely certify before a 5-state or nonstationary contradiction. All such claims remain tagged conditional and are withheld from the public certification API.
External scope attestation is a laboratory flag, not cryptographic or production-safe authorization.
State quotient is calculated for complete reference Moore machines; extracting the exact minimal quotient from incomplete evidence remains research.
Finite fully observed action IDs and two binary sensor channels are supplied; no image, language, or arbitrary program induction.
No language-model integration, changes to other projects, or physical electrical energy measurement.
